karty.priklad: Roedden ni'n ffodus iawn gyda'r tywydd.
karty.priklad_cs: We were very lucky with the weather (ff- doesn't mutate).
karty.mnemo: ffawd = fate: fate smiled on you.

extra.pozn: yn ffodus = fortunately, yn anffodus = unfortunately (L8); own example

sever.priklad: Roedden ni'n ffodus iawn efo'r tywydd.
sever.priklad_cs: We were very lucky with the weather.

karty.priklad: Mae'r trên yn brydlon heddiw, am unwaith!
karty.priklad_cs: The train is on time today, for once! (prydlon → [b]rydlon after yn)

karty.priklad: Wyt ti'n gwybod bod hwnna'n dangos dy fotwm bol di?
karty.priklad_cs: Do you know that one shows your belly button? (botwm → [f]otwm after dy; hwnna = that one, the top, masculine)
karty.mnemo: botwm (button) + bol (belly): a button sewn on your tummy.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine because of botwm; plural botymau bol (outside the coursebook); sentence from the dialogue Yn y siop chwaraeon, p. 234

karty.priklad: Dw i'n eistedd ar fy nhin gormod, felly dw i wedi dechrau dosbarth codi pwysau!
karty.priklad_cs: I sit on my backside too much, so I've started a weightlifting class! (tin → [nh]in after fy)

extra.pozn: in the box arall; a verb-noun like curo dwylo (L17); pwyso = to weigh (L15); nerth = strength (L18); sentence from the dialogue, p. 234

karty.cs: to lose (one's) hold (on), to lose one's grip; to lose control (of)
karty.priklad: Collais i afael ar y rhaff a chwympais i.
karty.priklad_cs: I lost my grip on the rope and fell (gafael → [a]fael as the object after collais i; rhaff doesn't mutate after y: rh-; cwympais → [ch]wympais after a).

extra.pozn: ar causes soft mutation (colli gafael ar raff); also in Robin Radio, p. 238; gafael yn dynn (L8), cwympo (L15); own example

sever.priklad: Collais i afael ar y rhaff a syrthiais i.
sever.priklad_cs: I lost my grip on the rope and fell.
sever.pozn: north: syrthio instead of cwympo (L14, L15)

karty.priklad: Mae chwant bwyd arna i. Beth am ginio?
karty.priklad_cs: I'm hungry (literally: there is hunger on me). How about lunch? (cinio → [g]inio after am)
karty.mnemo: CHWANT ~ WANT: you WANT food so badly you'd eat frozen fish fingers straight from the freezer.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine because of chwant; pattern Mae chwant bwyd ar + person (arna i, arnat ti…); chwant = desire, craving; own example

sever.priklad: Mae chwant bwyd arna i. Be am ginio?

karty.cs: packed to the rafters, packed out
karty.priklad: Camodd Owain ar y trên, oedd dan ei sang yn barod.
karty.priklad_cs: Owain stepped onto the train, which was already packed to the rafters (parod → [b]arod after yn).
karty.mnemo: sang = treading: everyone treading on everyone else's toes.

extra.pozn: fixed phrase, ei doesn't change (y neuadd dan ei sang); sentence from the reading Croesi'r Bont, L4, p. 48

karty.priklad: Roedd y nofel yn llyfr gosod yn yr ysgol.
karty.priklad_cs: The novel was a set book at school (llyfr doesn't mutate after yn: ll-).
karty.mnemo: gosod = to set, to place: the teacher sets on your desk the book you must read.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine because of llyfr; plural llyfrau gosod; gosod (L7); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n chwarae criced i dîm Bryncastell o dro i dro.
karty.priklad_cs: I play cricket for the Bryncastell team from time to time (tîm → [d]îm after i; tro → [d]ro after o and i).
karty.mnemo: tro = turn, while: from one turn to the next.

extra.pozn: weithiau = sometimes; am y tro (L12); sentence from the dialogue, p. 234

karty.priklad: Mae'r gân yn boblogaidd iawn ymhlith pobl ifanc.
karty.priklad_cs: The song is very popular among young people (cân → [g]ân after 'r, feminine; poblogaidd → [b]oblogaidd after yn).

extra.pozn: preposition; rhwng = between (two), ymhlith = among (many); yn ein plith = among us; own example

karty.priklad: Gwell i ti egluro beth ddigwyddodd!
karty.priklad_cs: You'd better explain what happened! (digwyddodd → [dd]igwyddodd after beth)
karty.mnemo: gwell = better: it'll be better if you explain.

extra.pozn: Gwell i + person + soft-mutated verb-noun (Gwell i fi fynd); egluro (L16); phrase from Robin Radio, p. 238

sever.priklad: Gwell i ti egluro be ddigwyddodd!

karty.slovo: Dw i'n mynd i ofyn iddi hi fy mhriodi i.
karty.cs: I'm going to ask her to marry me.
karty.priklad: Mae e'n mynd i ofyn iddi hi ei briodi e.
karty.priklad_cs: He's going to ask her to marry him (gofyn → [o]fyn after i; priodi → [b]riodi after ei = his).

extra.pozn: gofyn i rywun wneud rhywbeth = to ask someone to do something; fy mhriodi i (nasal after fy), ei briodi e (soft after ei = his); phrase from Robin Radio, p. 238

sever.priklad: Mae o'n mynd i ofyn iddi hi ei briodi o.
sever.priklad_cs: He's going to ask her to marry him.

karty.cs: to look; to seem, to look (+ adjective)
karty.priklad: Edrychwch ar honna! Mae honna'n edrych yn well.
karty.priklad_cs: Look at that one! That one looks better (gwell → [w]ell after yn; honna = that one, feminine).
karty.mnemo: drych = mirror: e-DRYCH, you look in the mirror.

extra.pozn: edrych ar = to look at, edrych yn + adjective = to look, to seem; card made because of sbio in the Geirfa of L18 (like cwympo/syrthio in L15); sentence based on the video Caffi'r Egin, p. 235

sever.priklad: Sbiwch ar honna! Mae honna'n edrych yn well.
sever.priklad_cs: Look at that one! That one looks better.
sever.pozn: north: sbio = to look (Geirfa L18, Y De a'r Gogledd); only in the sense "to look at", for "to seem" the north also uses edrych
